label: Moment — The Maker at Work
description: A trade portrait taken in the workshop rather than against a backdrop: the hands, the tools laid out the way that trade lays them out, and the light the room actually has. Reaches human/trade, which no other template touches.
prefix: An environmental portrait of a craftsperson at work — {trade}, {expression}, absorbed in the job. {trigger}
suffix: Workshop Rendering: (hands doing the actual work, described in full detail:1.3), (perfect hands, detailed fingers, correct grip on the tool:1.25), (material and dust of the trade everywhere — swarf, shavings, slip, flour:1.2), practical light from the window or the work itself, background left honestly cluttered.
negative: clean studio, empty background, posed to camera, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, watermark, text, logo, child, chibi, underage
